description: Return the unified activation posture — SDK heartbeat, ingested reports, GitHub, MCP readiness, QA stories, and the next best action. Read this before guessing which onboarding step is blocking the user. Also available as the mushi://activation resource for resource-reader clients. Returns { sdkActive, reportsIngested, githubConnected, mcpConnected, qaStoriesCreated, nextBestAction }.
